verdict.rationale: The evidence documents resolving errors. Slack messages include a resolve/reopen button, and unresolved errors are auto-resolved when a deploy is recorded. The Slack reopen is a manual action, not an automatic reopen when a resolved issue regresses. Missing for 10: assigning an owner, ignoring issues, snoozing issues, automatic reopen on regression, and any independent corroboration of the triage workflow.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can triage issues — assign an owner, resolve, ignore, or snooze — and the platform reopens a resolved issue automatically when it regresses

citations.quote: Messages about errors include a button to resolve or reopen the error
By default, all unresolved errors are automatically marked as resolved when a deployment is recorded
When you deploy, Honeybadger can automatically resolve open errors and notify your team.
